summary: Musquash Mountain tower in Topsfield, Maine: 1919 and 1929 Maine Forest Service maps show a lookout; FFLA lists it standing; a visitor found an old cab and five communications towers.

visit.trail_note: A forum visitor parked at the base of an unsigned road, Tower Rd, near Musquash Lake, and walked up a steep dirt road, saying a car could likely have made it. The visitor climbed a few flights of the old tower, found the steps badly bent and the handholds tenuous, and stopped.

notes_for_editor: No source I could read gives the date of the present tower or the last year it was staffed. A Facebook snippet from the FFLA Maine chapter reportedly describes three towers (1913-1928, 1928-1958, 1958 to present); the page would not open, so the 1958 date is not used. The forum post is undated in the page read and is one visitor's account, which may be old. A search summary said the trip report did not mention a cab; the thread does describe a square cab with a round roof, so the page was followed. Ownership and public access are not established by any source read, and the summit has five communications towers. Check with the Maine Forest Service or the FFLA Maine chapter before adding visiting advice.
